WITH signal_telescope AS (
  SELECT s.signalregistry, s.pulsepersec, t.equipstatus
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT equipstatus, AVG(pulsepersec) as avg_pulse_rate
  FROM signal_telescope
  GROUP BY equipstatus
),
first_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) as first_mean_val
  FROM status_averages
),
kept_first_filter AS (
  SELECT sa.equipstatus, sa.avg_pulse_rate,
         (sa.avg_pulse_rate - fm.first_mean_val) as excess_first
  FROM status_averages sa, first_mean fm
  WHERE sa.avg_pulse_rate > fm.first_mean_val
),
second_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) as second_mean_val
  FROM kept_first_filter
),
kept_second_filter AS (
  SELECT kf.equipstatus, kf.avg_pulse_rate, kf.excess_first,
         (kf.avg_pulse_rate - sm.second_mean_val) as excess_second
  FROM kept_first_filter kf, second_mean sm
  WHERE kf.avg_pulse_rate > sm.second_mean_val
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_pulse_rate) as final_avg_pulse_rate,
  AVG(excess_first) as avg_excess_over_first_mean,
  AVG(excess_second) as avg_excess_over_second_mean
FROM kept_second_filter;
